title: hbench dataset index, v1
description: The one layer (media type application/vnd.hbench.dataset-index.v1+json) of a registry's dataset index: an OCI image manifest with artifactType application/vnd.hbench.dataset-index.v1, tagged latest in <namespace>/index. It lists the dataset versions under <namespace>, so that `hbench datasets list --registry oci://<registry>/<namespace>` can name them; hbench opens each one by its digest and checks its name and version.

datasets.description: Every listed dataset version, at most once each.

version.description: The tag of the dataset version in its repository.

digest.description: The digest of the dataset's manifest, which the tag names.
